crop_bridge.image_branch: shared image cropper, base64 output at 232x64
crop_bridge.loading: Apply sets busy; progress keeps busy; complete/error/onerror clear busy
crop_bridge.termination: complete, worker error message, Cancel and component unmount terminate the worker
crop_bridge.initialization_error: worker onerror clears busy and logs; does not call terminate itself
crop_bridge.completion: forwards processed gifData and byte count to the isolated preset callback

native_zoom.buttons: step position by one; call relative zoom with +0.1 or -0.1
native_zoom.slider: down: (next - 11) / 10; up: next / 10; same position: no change
native_zoom.ratio: negative delta: multiply by 1 / (1 - delta); nonnegative: multiply by 1 + delta
native_zoom.reset: restore initial canvas geometry and slider position 1
native_zoom.preview_limit: viewMode 0: minimum canvas height 64; no 10x magnification cap; left in [-canvasWidth,232] and top in [-canvasHeight,190]. Native extreme-value guard: canvas edges at most 2^40 CSS pixels, above every u32 image initial canvas. Legacy zoom-only saved drafts retain their earlier preview.

worker_contract.delay: max(source frame delay, animationFPS === 15 ? 6 : 3), in GIF centiseconds

native_scope: Original local upload bytes plus reversible crop preview; no worker execution, processed GIF or device transfer.

background_work: GPUI image decode and EXIF orientation
native_import.completion: weak preset-editor entity update, latest file-selection generation and enabled slot rechecked before opening crop
native_import.local_preview: crop uses decoded RenderImage; restored data URLs use a native Asset cache rather than URI/HTTP loading
native_import.cache_lifetime: displayed-image leases share decoded data and remove the cache entry after the last preview disappears or changes content
native_import.local_guards: 64MiB encoded input and 256MiB resident-RGBA estimate are checked before decoding all supported formats; these are local safeguards, not vendor limits or a hard process-memory bound
native_import.accessibility: zoom buttons use current ZOOM_IN/ZOOM_OUT translations

limitations: Both production source maps return HTTP 404; current minified modules are parsed directly.
WASM validation covers its header and section bounds, not instruction semantics or equivalence to a native encoder.
Worker uses ImageMagick composite/resize/grayscale/optimization; Pillow preparation is not an equivalent custom-GIF processing implementation.
validation: Acorn AST, source slices, manifest URLs, HTTP receipts and SHA-256 only; no downloaded JavaScript or WASM execution.
